Pass a safe/multisig — not the deployer EOA — to satisfy the                           H PR2.2 / I5 requirement that the deployer is not sole board.                           May equal initialOwner only when no separate multisig is available                           (e.g. testnet single-signer setup); document the risk in README.
params.initialOwner: Contract owner (Ownable2Step pattern). Can emergency-revoke                           board members. Does NOT automatically receive boardRole (I5).

emergencyRevokeBoardRole(address).details: Intentionally asymmetric: owner can remove but not add without the board.         This prevents a rogue board member from being impossible to remove.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.expiresAt: Screening expiry (unix seconds). Max 2 years out.
params.pronouncementHash: keccak256 of the board resolution document.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_EXPIRY_PERIOD().notice: Maximum screening validity period (prevents stale entries).

TIMELOCK_PERIOD().notice: Minimum time between a proposal and its execution.

boardRole(address).notice: Board members who can propose + execute screening changes.

boardRoleProposals(address).notice: Pending board-role change proposals. Proposed by board, executed after timelock.

cancelProposal(address).notice: Cancel a pending proposal before it is executed.

emergencyRevokeBoardRole(address).notice: Owner-only emergency: revoke a board member immediately (pause power).

executeBoardRoleChange(address).notice: Any board member may execute a pending board-role change after the timelock.

executeRemoval(address).notice: Execute a pending removal after the timelock has elapsed.

executeScreening(address).notice: Execute a previously proposed screening after the timelock has elapsed.

getScreening(address).notice: Returns the full Screening struct for an adapter.

isBoard(address).notice: Single-source board membership query (I4).         CharityModule and PurificationEscrow call this instead of maintaining         their own local boardRole mappings, so governance changes propagate to         all contracts simultaneously.

isScreened(address).notice: Returns true only when the adapter is screened AND the screening         has not expired.  ShariahVaultV2 calls this before deployCapital.

proposeBoardRoleChange(address,bool).notice: A board member proposes granting or revoking board membership.         Owner alone cannot propose — only an existing board member can.

proposeRemoval(address).notice: Propose removal of a screened adapter.

proposeScreening(address,bytes32,uint256.notice: Propose a new or updated screening for an adapter.

@title  ShariahAdapterRegistry
 @notice Governance-gated registry of Shariah-screened strategy adapters.
 ## Design
 Every screening entry carries a `pronouncementHash` (keccak256 of the board
 resolution document) and an `expiresAt` timestamp.  ShariahVaultV2 queries
 this registry before any capital deployment.
 ## Timelock
 All add/update/remove operations must be *proposed* first, then *executed*
 after `TIMELOCK_PERIOD` has elapsed.  This prevents any single actor from
 silently slip-streaming an unscreened adapter.
 ## Roles
 - `BOARD_ROLE`   : can propose and execute screening changes
 - `owner`        : can grant/revoke BOARD_ROLE (Ownable)
 @dev    SR-005 through SR-011 are cited per adapter — see docs/agents/SHARIAH_REVIEW.md.
